items.exampleEn: My best friend always backs me up.
items.exampleZh: 我最好的朋友總是支持我。

items.exampleEn: My little brother always wants to come along when I go out with my friends.
items.exampleZh: 我跟朋友出去的時候，我弟弟總是想一起來。

items.exampleEn: The whole family dressed up for the wedding.
items.exampleZh: 全家人都為了婚禮盛裝打扮。

items.exampleEn: We got lost and ended up in a small village.
items.exampleZh: 我們迷路了，最後到了一個小村莊。

items.exampleEn: I don't know how I got through that week.
items.exampleZh: 我不知道那個星期我是怎麼撐過來的。

items.exampleEn: Dad opened the car door, and we all got in.
items.exampleZh: 爸爸打開車門，我們全都上了車。

items.exampleEn: Let's get out of here. This place is too noisy.
items.exampleZh: 我們離開這裡吧，這地方太吵了。

items.sentenceEn: My phone backs up my photos every night.
items.sentenceZh: 我的手機每天晚上都會備份我的照片。

items.audioEn: We were running late, so we got in a taxi and asked the driver to hurry.
items.audioZh: 我們快遲到了，所以搭上計程車，請司機開快一點。
options: It was raining very hard outside
Their own car did not start

items.sentenceEn: How is your English coming along?
items.sentenceZh: 你的英文進步得怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: Do I need to dress up for the dinner tonight?
items.sentenceZh: 今晚的晚餐我需要盛裝打扮嗎？

items.stemEn: We planned to stay home, but we ____ going to the beach.
items.stemZh: 我們本來打算待在家，結果最後去了海邊。

items.stemEn: When everyone else laughed at my plan, Kevin ____ my idea and said it was great.
items.stemZh: 大家都在笑我的計畫時，Kevin 支持我的點子，還說它很棒。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my cousin Lily was invited to a birthday party, and she asked me to come along. She told me everyone would dress up, so I wore my best shirt. When we got out of the taxi, we saw the other guests in jeans and T-shirts! Lily had the wrong information. I felt silly, but I got through the evening by laughing about it. We ended up dancing all night, and nobody cared about my shirt.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，我的表親 Lily 受邀參加一場生日派對，她叫我一起去。她說大家都會盛裝打扮，所以我穿了我最好的襯衫。我們下了計程車，卻看到其他客人都穿牛仔褲和 T 恤！Lily 的消息是錯的。我覺得自己很蠢，但我靠著自嘲撐過了那個晚上。結果我們跳舞跳了一整晚，根本沒人在意我的襯衫。

questions.questionZh: 作者為什麼穿了最好的襯衫？
options: 那天是作者自己的生日

items.promptZh: 我們今晚要去夜市，你想一起來嗎？
referenceEn: We're going to the night market tonight. Do you want to come along?
We are going to the night market tonight. Would you like to come along?
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 come along 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 come with us、join us 等）也算對
今晚的計畫可用現在進行式或其他表示未來的寫法（例如 are going to the night market、will go 等）
問句可寫，例如 Do you want to…?、Would you like to…? 等

items.promptZh: 我打了很多次電話給她，但都打不通。
referenceEn: I called her many times, but I couldn't get through.
I called her many times but couldn't get through.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 couldn't get through 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 couldn't reach her 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 called、have called 等）
「很多次」可寫，例如 many times、a lot of times 等
